name: qrtz_uran_lattice
description: BWR core lattice cell: 3px URAN column in a 1px QRTZ sleeve with a BOYL cell every 20 rows, next to a 3px INSL spacer holding a VACU cell every 4 rows. Repeat at 8px pitch for a full core.
why: Save 1186972 (Boiling water reactor BETA): the core (340-392,265-300) is this exact 8px cell repeated 7 times -- QRTZ/URAN columns with BOYL at y=275,295 and INSL spacers with VACU at y=274,278,...,298. URAN 301, QRTZ 480, VACU 45, BOYL 14 in the box. The VACU cells read 367-406C in the settled save, so the spacer is not cold -- it is part of the heat path. blueprint_lint flags every VACU cell as unwalled (pump_vacu_no_wall); accepted -- the cells are single pixels embedded in a solid INSL spacer exactly as in the source and act as local pressure sinks between fuel columns, not open vacuum.
